entries.body:
R1: CHG-113 APPLIED checkout-api 7.35.8 sets db.pool_max=-4 (round-01/changes.md:4, suspect BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT, no checkout errors in R1); CHG-110,114 benign. Slow query WARNs = noise. search-api /var/data 91-97% (round-01/logs/search-api.log:4,12,38,48).
R2: Thread A DISK_PRESSURE search-api + shipping-svc, ongoing (round-02/board.md:3). Follow-up OPEN CUSTOMER_COMMS (round-02/board.md:4). CHG-117 benign. R2 disk logs: round-02/logs/search-api.log:4-5,63 ; round-02/logs/shipping-svc.log:4,36. No checkout errors R2.
R3: Thread B MEMORY_LEAK auth-svc ongoing (round-03/board.md:3).
R3 logs: auth-svc shows tls certificate_expired peer=bank-api (round-03/logs/auth-svc.log:1,16,21,25,35,62), no memory evidence -> real cause likely CERT_EXPIRED, board says MEMORY_LEAK. No checkout errors R3.
R4: Thread A mitigated (round-04/board.md:3) via CHG-136 APPLIED search-api (round-04/changes.md:4). OPEN DATA_BACKFILL (board:4), VENDOR_TICKET (board:5). CHG-131 PROPOSED ignore.
R4 logs: auth cert_expired continues (round-04/logs/auth-svc.log:3,5,7). No checkout errors R4.
R5: OPEN CAPACITY_REVIEW (round-05/board.md:3).
R6: Thread D DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED checkout-api ongoing (round-06/board.md:3); likely from CHG-113 (round-01/changes.md:4). CHG-147 benign.
R6 logs: checkout db pool exhausted (round-06/logs/checkout-api.log:8,25,27,34,42); auth errors continue (round-06/logs/auth-svc.log:2,31-37). Search/shipping disk quiet R6.
R7: Thread A RESOLVED (round-07/board.md:3). Thread B cause revised CERT_EXPIRED auth-svc (round-07/board.md:4). OPEN ALERT_TUNING (board:5).
R7 logs: checkout db pool exhausted (round-07/logs/checkout-api.log:2,8,33,38,47); auth tls handshake failed peer=bank-api (round-07/logs/auth-svc.log:12,21,24,29).
R8: board says Thread D closed false alarm (round-08/board.md:3) - verify vs logs. CHG-156 PROPOSED ignore.
R8 logs: checkout-api has 75 lines with no pool/error lines, so Thread D false alarm is consistent (round-08/board.md:3); drop D unless it recurs. R8 auth tls failed continues (round-08/logs/auth-svc.log:6,9,29,32). R9: no board/changes.
R10: Thread C opened checkout-api request failures cause unknown, ongoing (round-10/board.md:3). CHG-173 PROPOSED ignore.
R10 logs: checkout config validation failed (round-10/logs/checkout-api.log:9,11,16,18,44,58) -> Thread C likely BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT via CHG-113; ledger-svc tls handshake failed (round-10/logs/ledger-svc.log:7,15,23,24,30,40) -> CERT_EXPIRED may spread to ledger; auth tls continues (round-10/logs/auth-svc.log:1,4,7,9).
R11: Thread B adds ledger-svc (round-11/board.md:3), B MITIGATED (round-11/board.md:4). Thread C still ongoing (board:5). CUSTOMER_COMMS CLOSED (board:6). CHG-179 PROPOSED ignore.
